not_just_an_ip_detector.note: 60%+ of malicious hosts in the corpus are raw IP literals, which is an easy signal. These two checks show how much of the result survives without it.

qualifications: Evaluated on REAL held-out hosts on both sides — not synthetic.
Feeds are live; re-running on another date produces a different corpus.
Benign labels come from Tranco, a POPULARITY list, not a safety list. A popular host is assumed benign unless it also appears in a malicious feed.
Host-only. The model cannot see a malicious path on an otherwise clean host; that is what the deterministic rules layer is for.
PhishTank is absent — its bulk download now requires a registered API key.
